LSE 0.5.8 builds on HRX main and verifies DFlash2 draft trees by default.

- macOS: needs mac_linuxgpu build 266 or later; the archive bundles the HSA runtime.
- Linux: needs the amdgpu kernel driver with KFD and access to `/dev/kfd`; the archive bundles the HSA runtime.

## Changes

- HRX main (ROCm/hrx-system) with two local patches: VRAM kernel arguments on gfx120x (#1331), loomc register-allocation fix (#1443).
- `--dflash2-tree=on|off`: verify a tree of draft candidates per target pass. Default follows `--adaptive-dflash2`.
- gfx1151: fused MLP gate/up GEMM, prefill attention with vector-loaded probability fragments and two query tiles per workgroup, matrix-panel DFlash2 feature projection.
- Kernels: grouped prefill GEMM epilogue as a measured variant; variant trials cover in-place inputs; loomc frees memory instruction sources at issue.
- Fixed a startup GPU fault: host DMA copies whole pages only.
- `LSE_CHECK_BINDINGS=1`: check each launch's buffers for liveness, bounds and kernel signature.
- `lse-server models`, `lse-server pull`, `--model ORG/NAME`: Hugging Face cache models with MTP or DFlash2 companions.
- Linux archive bundles TheRock ROCr 1.21 and the GCC 16 C++ runtime; needs glibc 2.38+.
